body:
Reported Player(s): legitboss44
Rules Broken: Team Griefing, he continued to break the staircase onto the enemy side, even after I said "stop" and without explaining why he was doing so, which I assume to be trolling.
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8FJhda957Ac


This is my first ever player report, I'm sorry if I did anything wrong, and feel free to tell me and correct me :D Perhaps only a temp ban/warning for this player, but it's up to you, the staff. Thanks :D
